title: Page builder: "บันทึกร่าง" (save draft) pushes page title, slug, SEO title/description, noindex, OG image and showInNav to the LIVE storefront immediately; only sections respect draft/publish
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/pages/actions.ts:118-121 (savePageDraft updates pages.title/slug/seo/showInNav on the live row) + apps/web/src/lib/tenant.ts:36-52 (getPublishedPage reads row.title/row.slug/row.seo; only sections come from publishedSections)
steps: Admin /t/demo-shop/pages -> new page qa-b2-imf1 -> add sections -> เผยแพร่. Then open 'ตั้งค่าหน้า & SEO', change ชื่อหน้า / SEO title / description, press บันทึก (toast 'บันทึกฉบับร่างแล้ว'). Next change the slug to qa-b2-imf1-renamed and save the draft again, do NOT publish. GET both URLs on the storefront.
expected: Draft changes stay invisible until เผยแพร่: the storefront keeps the old <title>/description and the old URL keeps working.
actual: Right after the draft save the storefront serves <title>QAB2-SEO-TITLE-imf1 · Siam Atelier</title> and meta description QAB2-SEO-DESC-imf1 while the sections are still the old published ones. After the draft-only slug rename the old URL returns 404 and the new one 200. noindex toggled in a draft is live at once (robots 'noindex, follow'). Staff (savePageDraft only needs assertRole staff, publishing needs manager) can therefore rename / noindex / retitle live non-home pages without publish rights (the home page <title> did not change in the same test).
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-pages.ts output: 'storefront after DRAFT save' {hero1:true, hero2:false, title:'QAB2-SEO-TITLE-imf1 · Siam Atelier', desc:'QAB2-SEO-DESC-imf1'}; admin_b2-pages2.ts: 'after draft-only slug rename' {toast:'บันทึกฉบับร่างแล้ว', oldUrl:404, newUrl:200}; 'noindex/og on storefront' {robots:'noindex, follow', og:'https://example.com/og.png'} before any publish.
suggestedFix: Keep a draft copy of the meta (e.g. pages.draft_meta jsonb, or put title/slug/seo/showInNav into the draft payload) and copy it to the live columns only in publishPage. If meta is meant to be live, say so in the UI (separate 'บันทึกการตั้งค่า (มีผลทันที)' button) and require manager for slug/noindex changes.

title: Page builder "ดูตัวอย่าง" (preview) opens the live storefront URL: a never-published page shows 404 and a published page shows the old published version, never the draft being edited
where: apps/admin/src/components/editor/section-editor.tsx:215 (previewHref = storefrontUrl + slug) and :268; the storefront has no draft/preview mode (apps/web/src/lib/tenant.ts getPublishedPage filters status = 'published')
steps: Admin /t/demo-shop/pages -> สร้างหน้า qa-b2-imf1 -> add 20 sections -> บันทึกร่าง -> click ดูตัวอย่าง (href http://demo-shop.localhost:3000/qa-b2-imf1). Then publish, edit the hero heading, save the draft, click ดูตัวอย่าง again.
expected: Preview renders the current draft (signed preview token / draft mode) so the owner can check the page before publishing.
actual: Draft page: the storefront answers 404 (owner sees the shop's 404 page). Published page with draft edits: the storefront still shows the old heading (QAB2-HERO-imf1, not the draft QAB2-HERO2-imf1). There is no way to look at a draft before it goes live.
evidence: admin_b2-pages.ts: preview href http://demo-shop.localhost:3000/qa-b2-imf1; 'storefront while draft' {status:404}; 'storefront after DRAFT save' {hero1:true, hero2:false}.
suggestedFix: Add a preview entry on the storefront (e.g. /api/preview?token=<signed pageId+exp> enabling Next draftMode; getPublishedPage then reads pages.sections for that id) and point ดูตัวอย่าง at it. At minimum rename the button 'ดูหน้าที่เผยแพร่' and disable it for never-published pages.

title: Page slugs "staff" and "packages" are accepted, but on booking/clinic tenants the storefront module routes shadow them (page can be published yet is never shown)
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/pages/actions.ts:31 RESERVED_PAGE_SLUGS (no 'staff', 'packages') vs apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/staff/page.tsx and packages/page.tsx
steps: Admin -> หน้าเว็บ -> สร้างหน้า with slug 'staff' (accepted, editor opens; same for 'packages'). Publish such a page on demo-salon (/staff) or demo-clinic (/packages) and open the URL.
expected: The slug is refused like checkout/account ('slug นี้ถูกสงวนไว้สำหรับระบบ'), or the CMS page is reachable.
actual: demo-shop accepted slugs staff and packages (create redirected to the editor). With a published CMS page /staff on demo-salon the storefront renders the module page (title 'ทีมผู้ให้บริการ · สบาย สบาย', CMS marker absent). demo-clinic /packages renders 'คอร์สและแพ็กเกจ · Lumière Clinic' and the CMS page is invisible.

suggestedFix: Add staff and packages (and any future top-level module route) to RESERVED_PAGE_SLUGS, ideally from one list shared with the storefront route folders, or reserve them only while the owning module is enabled.

title: Brand-new salon/clinic tenants (no PromptPay, no bank account) still demand a deposit by bank transfer: the booking page asks the customer to upload a slip but shows no account to pay to; the slot is held 30 min, then auto-cancelled
where: packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:403-415 enabledMethods() ('if (!out.length) out.push("slip")' fallback, bank transfer counted without any account) used by packages/modules/booking/src/services/bookings.ts:139-141 createBookingPayment and clinic.ts:207/265 (package purchase / visit payments). Commerce got checkoutPaymentMethods() (COR-23) but booking/clinic did not.
steps: Sign up a new owner, onboarding -> template 'จองคิว ซาลอน / สปา / นวด' (qa-b2-salon-sppp; settings.payments = {enabled:{promptpay:true, bankTransfer:true}} with no promptpayId / bankAccounts). On the storefront open /book?service=aroma-90 (template service with depositRequired ฿300), pick any staff/date/slot, enter name + phone, ยืนยันการจอง.
expected: While the shop has no payment receiver, deposit services either cannot be booked online or are booked without a deposit, and the customer sees a clear notice that the shop has not set up payments (owner is told to configure PromptPay / bank account).
actual: Review step shows 'ชำระตอนนี้ (มัดจำ) ฿300 · วิธีชำระมัดจำ โอนเงินผ่านธนาคาร โอนแล้วแนบสลิปในหน้าถัดไป'. Booking BK-1001 is created as 'รอชำระมัดจำ' with 'ยอดที่ต้องชำระ ฿300 หมดอายุใน 29:57 แนบสลิปโอนเงิน' and no bank name/account number anywhere on the page; the customer cannot pay, and the booking is cancelled when the timer runs out. Same template marks 2 salon and 4 clinic services (incl. featured Botox/HIFU) as deposit-required.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-newbook.ts output ('review step', 'booking page'); screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_b2-book-new-salon-deposit.png; admin_b2-onboard.ts: tenant salon payments {enabled:{promptpay:true,bankTransfer:true}} (no receivers).
suggestedFix: Reuse the commerce rule (method enabled AND has a receiver; no 'slip' fallback) in booking/clinic: when no deposit method is available skip the deposit (or block online booking of deposit services) and show 'ร้านยังไม่ได้ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับชำระเงิน'; surface the same warning on the admin dashboard / services page.

title: New shop/cafe checkout blames the shipping method instead of saying the shop has not set up payments: 'วิธีจัดส่งนี้ยังไม่มีช่องทางชำระเงินที่รองรับ กรุณาเลือกวิธีจัดส่งอื่น' on the default (free) shipping option
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/components/checkout-form.tsx:82 (paymentNotice = methods.length ? L.noPaymentForShipping : L.noPaymentReceiver) with template default payments.enabled.cod = true -> methods = ['cod']
steps: New owner -> onboarding template 'ร้านค้าออนไลน์' (qa-b2-shop-sppp) and 'คาเฟ่' (qa-b2-cafe-sppp), configure nothing. Storefront: open a product, เพิ่มลงตะกร้า, /checkout (phone viewport).
expected: Checkout clearly says the shop has not configured PromptPay / bank transfer yet ('ร้านค้ายังไม่ได้ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับชำระเงิน …', the message that exists as L.noPaymentReceiver) and only offers what really works (COD); the owner gets the same hint.
actual: With the pre-selected shipping 'Flash Express (ส่งด่วน) ส่งฟรี' there are no payment radios, 'สั่งซื้อและชำระเงิน' is disabled and the only text is 'วิธีจัดส่งนี้ยังไม่มีช่องทางชำระเงินที่รองรับ กรุณาเลือกวิธีจัดส่งอื่น'. The clear 'shop has not set up payments' notice is never shown because COD (enabled by the template) makes methods non-empty. Same on the new cafe.
evidence: admin_b2-checkout.ts / admin_b2-checkout2.ts: 'payment radios: []', 'submit button {disabled:true}', checkout text '... วิธีชำระเงิน วิธีจัดส่งนี้ยังไม่มีช่องทางชำระเงินที่รองรับ กรุณาเลือกวิธีจัดส่งอื่น ...'; admin_b2-newpay.ts cafe: same text; screenshots tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_b2-checkout-new-qa-b2-shop-sppp.png, bughunt-admin_b2-checkout-new-cafe.png.
suggestedFix: Show L.noPaymentReceiver whenever no prepaid receiver (PromptPay ID / bank account) is configured, adding 'เลือกเก็บเงินปลายทางได้' when COD is available; consider defaulting the selected shipping to one that has a usable payment method.

title: Corporate (CMS-only) tenants get a checklist that can never reach 100%: 'เพิ่มรายการจริงอย่างน้อย 1 รายการ' has no completion path and 'ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับเงิน' is asked although the site cannot take payments
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/dashboard/queries.ts:65-66 (content done = realItem || steps.content; realItem only computed for commerce/restaurant/booking/topup in dashboard/kpis.ts:42-103; steps.content is never written anywhere)
steps: Onboarding -> 'เว็บบริษัท / เอเจนซี่' (qa-b2-corp-sppp, modules ['cms']) -> dashboard checklist.
expected: Checklist items match the site type (e.g. 'publish/edit your first page' for CMS sites) and payment setup is not required for a site with no payment module.
actual: Checklist shows 'เพิ่มรายการจริงอย่างน้อย 1 รายการ — สินค้า บริการ เมนูอาหาร หรือเกมของคุณเอง' (links to /pages; editing pages never completes it) and 'ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับเงิน PromptPay ID หรือบัญชีธนาคาร' for a CMS-only site; the progress bar cannot reach 100%.
evidence: admin_b2-onboard.ts 'tenant corporate' checklist text (modules ['cms']); grep: no writer of onboarding.steps.content (only design/actions.ts writes steps.theme/logo).
suggestedFix: Build the checklist from the enabled modules: for cms-only use 'แก้ไข/เผยแพร่หน้าแรก' (done when the home page was published after provisioning) and drop the payments item when no payment-taking module is enabled.

title: New tenants' sample About/testimonial copy still tells the demo brand's story under the owner's shop name (Siam Atelier, Sugar Puff, สบาย สบาย, บ้านริม, Northstar)

title: Sign-up API accepts an empty or 5000-character name and a password of 8 spaces (only the client form validates)
where: apps/admin/src/lib/auth-config.ts:20-24 (emailAndPassword: minPasswordLength 8, no name/password content validation); client-only checks in apps/admin/src/app/(auth)/signup/signup-form.tsx:27-29
steps: POST /api/auth/sign-up/email (admin origin) with {name:'', ...}, {name:'ก'x5000, ...} and {password:'        '}.
expected: 400 for an empty/oversized name and a whitespace-only password, same rules as the form (name >= 2 chars after trim).
actual: All three return 200 with a session token (users qa-b2-nm…, qa-b2-ln…, qa-b2-sp… created); a 7-char password is correctly rejected (400 PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT). The empty/huge name then shows up in team lists and audit logs.
evidence: admin_b2-onboard.ts: 'api spaces pw' {status:200}, 'api empty name' {status:200, name:''}, 'api 5000-char name' {status:200}; 'api short pw' {status:400}.

title: A contact phone silently becomes the PromptPay receiver: a landline (02-123-4567) turns on PromptPay checkout with an unpayable QR for '0066 2 123 4567' labelled 'ยืนยันอัตโนมัติ', while the dashboard says payments are not set up
where: packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:393-400 resolvePromptpayId (falls back to settings.contact.phone when payments.promptpayId is empty, any number with >= 9 digits) used by commerce checkoutPaymentMethods (packages/modules/commerce/src/services/orders.ts:64) and booking/clinic payments
steps: New tenant qa-b2-shop-sppp (no PromptPay ID / bank account). Admin /t/<slug>/settings: ข้อมูลติดต่อ phone = 02-123-4567 -> บันทึก. Storefront: add a product, /checkout, choose สแกน PromptPay, place the order.
expected: A contact phone is only a contact phone. PromptPay is offered only after the owner enters a PromptPay ID in Settings > Payments (or the fallback is shown and confirmed there, restricted to 10-digit mobile numbers).
actual: Checkout immediately offers 'สแกน PromptPay · สแกน QR แล้วแนบสลิป ยืนยันอัตโนมัติ'. Order #1001 was created with payment qr_payload '...29370016A000000677010111 0113 0006621234567...' i.e. PromptPay target +66 2 123 4567 (a landline that cannot be a PromptPay ID), so the customer cannot pay. With a mobile number (089-999-0005) the QR goes to whoever owns that number. The dashboard checklist keeps 'ตั้งค่าช่องทางรับเงิน' open and Settings > Payments shows an empty PromptPay ID; the only hint is the card description there ("หากเว้นว่างระบบจะใช้เบอร์โทรร้าน (02-123-4567)"), which does not check that the number can be a PromptPay ID (a 9-digit landline is accepted).
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-settings.ts: 'checkout with contact phone 02-123-4567 only' {radios:['promptpay_qr'], payText:'วิธีชำระเงิน สแกน PromptPay ... ยืนยันอัตโนมัติ', order #1001}, 'latest payment (landline)' {method:'promptpay_qr', qr:'00020101021229370016A00000067701011101130006621234567530376454071890.005802TH63045C00'}; 'checkout with contact mobile only' {radios:['promptpay_qr']}. After setting a real PromptPay ID (0899990006) the QR correctly targets 0066899990006 (admin_b2-co4.ts).
suggestedFix: Drop the contact-phone fallback in resolvePromptpayId (or only show it as a suggestion in Settings > Payments that the owner must save). If kept, accept only 10-digit mobile numbers (06/08/09) and display the effective PromptPay target in Settings > Payments and the checklist.

title: LINE ID saved without '@' produces a dead chat link (https://line.me/R/ti/p/qab2plain) on the floating 'แชตผ่าน LINE' button, contact section and footer
where: packages/storefront/src/shell/floating-chat.tsx:16, footer.tsx:35, sections/contact.tsx:39 (`https://line.me/R/ti/p/${encodeURIComponent(lineId)}`); input apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/settings/general-form.tsx:66-67 has no normalisation/validation
steps: Admin Settings > ทั่วไป > LINE ID = qab2plain (Thai owners often type the OA id without '@' or a personal LINE ID) -> บันทึก. Open the storefront home and inspect the floating LINE button.
expected: Either the id is normalised (prefix '@' for official accounts, or use https://line.me/ti/p/~<id> for personal IDs) or the field validates/explains the required format; the link opens a chat.
actual: Button href = https://line.me/R/ti/p/qab2plain, which LINE does not resolve (the /R/ti/p/ form needs '@basicId'). With '@qab2line' the link is https://line.me/R/ti/p/%40qab2line (works).
evidence: admin_b2-co3.ts: home LINE anchors ['https://line.me/R/ti/p/qab2plain | แชตผ่าน LINE'] after saving 'qab2plain'.
suggestedFix: Normalise on save: trim, if it does not start with '@' and is not a URL, ask whether it is an official account (prefix '@') or personal (store lineUrl https://line.me/ti/p/~<id>); or accept a full LINE URL and store it as contact.lineUrl.

title: Unverified custom domains are routed live: a hostname added in Settings > Domains serves the claiming tenant's storefront while still 'pending' and after DNS verification 'failed'; the first claim also blocks the real domain owner
where: packages/core/src/tenant/resolve.ts:66-72 resolveTenantByHost (joins tenant_domains by hostname with no status = 'active' filter); apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/settings/actions.ts:96-113 addDomain (global uniqueness check, no verification needed to claim)
steps: Owner of qa-b2-shop-sppp: Settings > โดเมน > add 'https://WWW.QA-B2-SPPP.TEST/some/path' (stored as www.qa-b2-sppp.test, status pending). GET http://127.0.0.1:3000/ with Host: www.qa-b2-sppp.test. Click 'ตรวจสอบ DNS' (fails: no TXT) and GET again. Then try to add the same hostname from another tenant (qa-b2-cafe-sppp).
expected: A custom domain only routes to a tenant after TXT + CNAME verification (status active); unverified claims expire or can be taken over by whoever proves DNS ownership.
actual: Pending domain: 200 with <title>QA B2 Shop sppp</title>. After verify -> status 'failed' ('ไม่พบ TXT record ที่ _rentweb.www.qa-b2-sppp.test') it still serves 200 QA B2 Shop sppp. The second tenant gets 'โดเมนนี้ถูกใช้งานแล้ว'. So any tenant can pre-claim a business's hostname without owning it: once that business points its CNAME at RentWeb (as the domains page instructs) its traffic and customers land on the squatter's shop, and the real owner cannot add the domain.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-team.ts output: 'db domain' {status:'pending'}, 'storefront via PENDING domain' {status:200, title:'QA B2 Shop sppp'}, 'db domain after verify' {status:'failed'}, 'storefront via FAILED domain' {status:200, title:'QA B2 Shop sppp'}, 'same host on 2nd tenant' -> 'โดเมนนี้ถูกใช้งานแล้ว'; admin_b2-dbpeek.ts lists www.qa-b2-sppp.test status failed on the shop tenant.
suggestedFix: Filter resolveTenantByHost on tenant_domains.status = 'active' (and invalidate the host cache on verify/remove); let a pending claim be replaced by another tenant that passes TXT verification, and expire pending claims after N days.

title: Team invite for a person without an account loses the invitation: login page 'สมัครสมาชิก' link drops ?next=/invite/<token> and sign-up always goes to /onboarding (create-your-website wizard)
where: apps/admin/src/app/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:73 (<Link href="/signup"> without next) and apps/admin/src/app/(auth)/signup/signup-form.tsx:38-39 (router.push('/onboarding') unconditionally; signup/page.tsx has no next param)

title: "บล็อกลูกค้า" does not stop a blocked customer from ordering: guest checkout with the same phone creates a new order attached to the blocked customer; OTP login just bounces back to the login form with no message
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/customers/actions.ts:37-47 toggleCustomerBlock (only sets customers.blocked_at); the only enforcement is packages/core/src/customer/index.ts:61 getCustomerByToken (session lookup). actual: Order #1004 (฿3,780, PromptPay) was created and linked to the blocked customer (orders.customer_id = blocked customer id). OTP verify with the correct code returns to the empty login form ('เข้าสู่ระบบ / สมัครสมาชิก ... ขอรหัส OTP') without any explanation.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-customers.ts: 'db blockedAt' {blockedAt:'2026-10-16T22:32:23Z'}; 'blocked customer guest checkout ->' /orders/01a146d8-...?k=... 'คำสั่งซื้อ #1004'; 'latest order' {number:'#1004', sameBlockedCustomer:true}; 'blocked customer after OTP verify' {url:'.../account/login', text:'เข้าสู่ระบบ / สมัครสมาชิก ...'}; screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_b2-blocked-customer-login.png.

title: Page builder image upload silently fails for managers and staff: it calls the admin-only uploadBrandAsset, the 'คุณไม่มีสิทธิ์ดำเนินการนี้' error is thrown uncaught (no toast, image stays empty)

title: Without Upstash (dev default, empty in .env.example) admin cache invalidation never reaches the storefront process: suspend/reactivate take up to 5 min and settings up to 60 s, while the UI says 'ทันที' / 'ไม่กี่วินาที'
where: packages/core/src/cache.ts:71-87 getCache() falls back to a per-process MemoryCache; packages/core/src/tenant/resolve.ts:18-19 HOST_TTL 300 / CONFIG_TTL 60 and :125 invalidateTenant() only deletes keys in the calling (admin, port 3001) process; storefront (port 3000) keeps its own copy
steps: (1) Console: set qa-b2-corp-sppp to ระงับ, then back to ทดลองใช้ (อัปเดตสถานะ) and poll the storefront. (2) Owner danger zone: ระงับชั่วคราว, then เปิดใช้งาน ('หน้าร้านจะกลับมาออนไลน์ทันที'), poll. (3) Settings > ทั่วไป: change the tagline on qa-b2-cafe-sppp and poll the storefront home.
expected: Status and settings changes are visible on the storefront within a few seconds (or the cache is shared/invalidated across apps), as the dialogs promise.
actual: (1) After reactivation the storefront kept answering 503 'เว็บไซต์นี้ปิดปรับปรุงชั่วคราว' until 05:53:02, about 5 minutes later. (2) Self-suspend: storefront still served the shop for 45 s; self-reactivate: 503 for 300 s. (3) New tagline appeared after 57 s. A platform suspension of a fraudulent shop therefore leaves it selling for up to 5 minutes, and owners think their change did not save. Note: docs/03-tech-stack.md plans Upstash Redis for production, where invalidation is shared (5 s local memo), so this hits dev/QA and any Redis-less self-hosted deployment; it also makes other QA checks of storefront changes look flaky.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-danger.log: 'storefront 503 after (s): 45', 'storefront 200 after (s): 300'; admin_b2-console.ts 'storefront after reactivate' {status:503} + curl poll 503 ... 05:53:02 200; admin_b2-stale.ts 'tagline visible on storefront after: 57 s'; .env has no UPSTASH_* keys, .env.example leaves them empty.
suggestedFix: Make the shared cache mandatory (fail fast / loud warning at boot when UPSTASH_* is missing in a multi-app setup) or add a cross-process invalidation path (Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY, or a signed POST from admin to a storefront /api/internal/invalidate); at least lower HOST_TTL for the status field or re-check tenant status from the DB on suspended/reactivated tenants.

title: Stored XSS on every product page: product name (also short description, SKU, shop name) is written into the JSON-LD <script> with plain JSON.stringify, so a manager can break out with '</script><script>…'
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/products/[slug]/page.tsx:68-84 (jsonLd uses product.name, shortDescription, sku, runtime.config.name) and :197 <script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd) }} /> (JSON.stringify does not escape '<')
steps: As the ผู้จัดการ (manager) member of qa-b2-shop-sppp: /t/<slug>/products/<id> -> set the product name to 'กางเกงขากว้าง ผ้าฝ้ายซักนุ่ม</script><script>window.__b2=document.domain</script>' (validation allows 200 chars) -> บันทึกสินค้า. Open http://qa-b2-shop-sppp.localhost:3000/products/wide-pants in a browser.
expected: The name is shown as text everywhere; inside JSON-LD '<' is escaped (\u003c) so no script runs.
actual: 'บันทึกสินค้าแล้ว'; on the storefront the injected script executes for every visitor: window.__b2 === 'qa-b2-shop-sppp.localhost'. The script runs on the tenant origin, so it can read the signed-in customer's account pages (addresses, orders) and act as them. A manager (not only the owner) can do this; the same sink takes shortDescription, sku and the shop name. (Product name restored after the test.)
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/admin_b2-jsonld.ts output: 'manager save product: บันทึกสินค้าแล้ว', db name contains the payload, 'storefront window.__b2: qa-b2-shop-sppp.localhost'; the RSC payload shows the raw '</script><script>' inside the ld+json __html.
suggestedFix: Serialize JSON-LD with an escaper (JSON.stringify(jsonLd).replace(/</g, '\\u003c').replace(/>/g, '\\u003e').replace(/&/g, '\\u0026') plus U+2028/2029), ideally one shared helper used for every ld+json/inline script; add a regression test with a '</script>' product name.
